question: Exploratory native CPU attribution of unchanged Rust on a fixed historical target; no throughput or speedup inference.

claims.text: Both profiled workers return the exact complete ordered relation set for the fixed target. Profiles are attribution only, not speed evidence.

arms.description: Unchanged newton under GNU gprofng1ms software timer, no speed comparison.
Unchanged half under GNU gprofng1ms software timer, no speed comparison.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exploratory attribution only; no comparative speed or null inference.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Attribution only; nonempty native sample output and exact worker output are required. Subsequent speed experiment will use full controls.

negative.not_applicable_reason: No comparative/statistical null inference; fixed target profile only.

factors.name: representation_field_and_m
factors.how: Keep configurations separate. Rational fixtures are Mobius conjugates of squaring, not auxiliary-isogeny search benchmarks. Word62 has no prime-order subgroup assertion; P224 standard curve.

factors.name: target_population
factors.how: Alternating inputs, same exact target across all arms; identity separate.

factors.name: instrument
factors.value: One immutable native release binary, locked dependencies, one CPU.

factors.name: arm_order
factors.how: Attribution discovery only; profiled clocks cannot decide speed.

factors.name: host_environment
factors.how: Unmodified isolated_bench CPU4; missing PSI/unmovable host threads mean below-L2 clocks.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Raw per-input values/ranges retained; no statistical significance test.

factors.name: construction_backend
factors.value: KaratsubaNewton for all descriptor/certification work; query backend only is changed for C-half
factors.how: Each arm freshly builds its descriptor. Lookup additionally builds its required point table/hash set; candidates build no unused table for finite targets. Counter phases remain separate.

comparisons.threshold: Exact complete relation-set equality and nonempty native sampling table; no speed criterion.

seed_derivation.note: Fixed published input003 target, configuration seed in profile-inputs/config-original.json, root seed0x53500000+3=1397751811; no regenerated target.

instance_sampling.rule: One published conditioned finite word62/m16384 target, identical across arms; no population inference.

blinding.how: Explicit unblinded deterministic descriptive analysis frozen before data; no inferential selection or posthoc dispatch.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Fixed discovery order; profiler perturbation precludes throughput comparison.

power.note: Exploratory attribution only; n1 per backend, no significance or speed inference.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Conservative45s per-profile planning cap, not a measured timing estimate.

primary.name: Fresh construction plus query field multiplications
primary.definition: Every arm freshly executes descriptor/full sibling-fiber certification AND full point factor-base lifting; lookup also hashes. Primitive muls include inverse/sqrt internals. Memory/hash/sort unpriced in counts; included in clocks. Setup teardown, process startup, fixture draw and scalar verification excluded. All successful raw total_work fields equal construction_work+query_work.

primary.name: Complete ordered relations
primary.definition: Complete ordered pair array and SHA compared across all arms, then native BigUint scalar replay.

secondary.name: Local diagnostic cold/query elapsed intervals
secondary.definition: Profiled worker clocks are retained only as perturbed diagnostics, never speed observations.
secondary.resolution: monotonic Instant, actual host resolution recorded

stopping_rules.rule: Exactly1 newton and1 half profile,45s each,120s outer, no retries.
Nonzero collection exit or wrong complete relation set stops; preserve failed bytes. Empty samples do not support attribution.

decision_rule.text: No speed/throughput decision. Preserve native function/sample tables and complete-set checks; choose the next optimization hypothesis only after the profile.
decision_rule.statistic: Native GNU gprofng function and CPU sample tables, exploratory only.
decision_rule.interval: Observed range, not a confidence interval.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: None; subsequent unprofiled controlled measurement decides improvement.

inadmissible: Pool populations/configurations/identities or calibration with main
Omit full construction or treat lookup setup as free
Promote diagnostic clocks to L2 or counters to wall speedup
Call Mobius-Kummer fixtures auxiliary-isogeny search costs
Self-sign general degree argument or claim complete formal tower instantiation
Paid/cloud experiments or local S3 operations

literature.ref: FLINTv3.3.1 src/nmod_poly/hgcd.c and src/gr_poly/hgcd.c; src/cryptanalysis/isogeny_eval/poly.rs; ic_framework/prime_tower.rs
literature.claim: Standard recursive polynomial half reduction, counted multiplication and normalized Velu-map source assumptions. No novelty claim.
literature.verified_by: Producer primary/internal source read; KB MCP/wrapper unavailable.

invalidation_rules: Complete-set mismatch invalidates instrument; no arm omission after failure.
Local clocks remain diagnostic/wall_valid=false below L2.
A/A controls and positive detection must be reported, never silently discarded.
